thread:
emm: Quick design sync — we're getting mixed feedback on the left rail reorg. Two asks: 1) make deep links reliable during rollout, 2) make breadcrumb context clearer when items move between clusters. Thoughts? :wave:
pm_julie: Users liked grouping but missed the old anchor names. We should keep legacy slugs and friendly labels. Also prefer 'Deployments' over 'Deploy' for clarity.
sam_frontend: Technically straightforward: keep canonical routes like `/workspaces/:id/deployments` and accept legacy paths with a client-side redirect. Will add a small migration banner when users hit an alias.
router_olivia: prefer server-side rewrites to avoid client churn and analytics fragmentation. We can add a header X-Original-Path for a short window so analytics can map hits. Avoid multiple hops.
a11y_jai: Breadcrumbs need clear separators and programmatic landmarking. If cluster becomes an extra crumb, make it keyboard focusable and a landmark region. Also ensure hover/focus text for icon-only nav.
ux_ana: ran 8 guerilla tests — participants scan left-to-right and expect primary actions near the top. Clustering helped testers find "Deployments" faster when label was explicit. Recommendation: label clusters with nouns, not verbs.
opsbot: Created ticket RDW-3102: add route aliases + analytics passthrough header. Created subtask RDW-3102a: migration banner copy A/B.
emm: Proposed breadcrumb pattern: Workspace > ClusterLabel (e.g., Deployments) > ResourceName > Subpage. This makes cluster context explicit. Any objections?
pm_julie: no objections, but add 'Back to workspace' affordance in top-left for users who lose context.
sam_frontend: implementation detail: will use `nav-group` role and `aria-expanded` for collapsible clusters. For breadcrumbs, we can render cluster as a link when it maps to a landing view.
router_olivia: route sketch:
```
GET /w/:wid/infra/deploy -> rewrite -> /workspaces/:wid/deployments
GET /w/:wid/models -> rewrite -> /workspaces/:wid/models/catalog
```
We'll log original path in `X-Original-Path` and expire logging after 30 days.
a11y_jai: small a11y checklist: 1) cluster headings use heading semantics, 2) icon-only items have aria-label + visible focus, 3) breadcrumb separators use `aria-hidden="true"` and accessible text for screen readers. I'll post the checklist.
ux_ana: copy options for migration banner: A) "Navigation updated: here's where your Deployments moved." B) "We've reorganized the sidebar — view the new layout or return to the old link." We'll test tone.
opsbot: RDW-3102b created: telemetry flag `nav_v2_rollout` to gate experiments.
emm: ok next steps: Sam to mock cluster landing + breadcrumb state, Olivia to prepare rewrite plan and header, Ana to run two A/B banners in test, Jai to validate a11y checklist. We'll reconvene after the prototype. Thanks all :heart:
